caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank labeled "STUMP SPEAKER BANK" on the front and side, with the text embossed in yellow on a red rectangular base. A caricatured figure stands on top of the base, dressed in a green suit with yellow vest, white shirt, and red bow tie. The figure has exaggerated facial features, dark skin, red lips, and is wearing a small, worn-looking top hat that is mostly off-white with blue accents. One arm is extended forward, while the other is bent at the elbow. Next to the figure is an object resembling a brown textured satchel or bag. A lever is positioned to the right of the caricatured figure. The surface on which these objects stand appears metallic and slightly worn. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist’s name, "Florian Rokita," written at the bottom right.
title: Stump Speaker Bank
